description: This file contains extension methods for reading variable-width integers (varints) in a serialization context, including methods for reading different integer types with support for various wire types and ZigZag decoding.

classes.name: VarIntReaderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for reading variable-width integers with support for different wire types and ZigZag decoding.

methods.name: ReadVarInt8
methods.description: Reads a variable-width sbyte using ZigZag decoding from the reader.

methods.name: ReadVarInt16
methods.description: Reads a variable-width short using ZigZag decoding from the reader.

methods.name: ReadVarUInt8
methods.description: Reads a variable-width byte from the reader.

methods.name: ReadVarUInt16
methods.description: Reads a variable-width ushort from the reader.

methods.name: ReadVarInt32
methods.description: Reads a variable-width int using ZigZag decoding from the reader.

methods.name: ReadVarInt64
methods.description: Reads a variable-width long using ZigZag decoding from the reader.

methods.name: ReadUInt8
methods.description: Reads a byte from the reader based on the specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadUInt16
methods.description: Reads a ushort from the reader based on the specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadUInt32
methods.description: Reads a uint from the reader based on the specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadUInt64
methods.description: Reads a ulong from the reader based on the specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadInt8
methods.description: Reads an sbyte from the reader based on the specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadInt16
methods.description: Reads a short from the reader based on the specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadInt32
methods.description: Reads an int from the reader based on the specified wire type, with a slower fallback for certain wire types.

methods.name: ReadInt64
methods.description: Reads a long from the reader based on the specified wire type.
